description: Small authored synthetic corpus for local retrieval/citation contracts. It deliberately includes exact terms, CJK queries, long tails, repeated-term distractors, reviewed corrections and no-answer queries. Cases are not held-out external evaluation, semantic-quality evidence or production workload.

documents.title: Atlas release readiness
documents.content:
The Atlas release review is scheduled for Friday at 09:30. Mira owns the deployment checklist. The rollback trigger is a failed health probe for five minutes.
The release coordinator must obtain exact approval before creating a private calendar hold.

documents.title: Finance reconciliation
documents.content: The finance reconciliation closes on Tuesday at 16:00. Expense receipts must include the invoice number. The approval committee reviews the budget, not calendar holds.

documents.title: Training room booking
documents.content: The team training workshop is on Friday at 15:00. The training coordinator books Room Cedar. Deployment and health probes are outside this workshop.

documents.title: 审批回执设计评审
documents.content: 审批提案绑定参数摘要，参数变化必须重新审批。外部提交响应丢失时进入待核对状态，恢复过程先观察外部结果。精确回执验证通过后才继续下一动作。

documents.title: 行政会议安排
documents.content: 周五行政会议讨论会议室审批、报销回执和员工培训。行政会议不会修改 Agent 的外部动作参数，也不负责提交恢复。

documents.title: Draft-only mailbox policy
documents.content: Mailbox access permits creating an email draft for operator review. The connector must never send the email. Draft verification compares recipient, subject and body against the approved effect.

documents.title: Private calendar policy
documents.content: Private calendar holds must have no attendees. The connector never sends invitations. The approved title, start time, end time and time zone must match the observed event.

documents.title: 私人日程接口
documents.content: 私人日程不添加参与者，不发送邀请。日程观察结果必须核对标题、开始时间、结束时间与时区。创建前需操作者批准。

documents.title: Worker lease incidents
documents.content: A task lease expires when its heartbeat stops. The next worker receives a new lease epoch. A stale worker cannot publish artifacts after the epoch changes.

documents.title: Task branch isolation
documents.content: Each task writes to its own Git worktree. Independent submission review reads the changed files and runs integration tests. A worktree is a repository checkout, not an operating-system sandbox.

documents.title: Knowledge version activation
documents.content: Knowledge documents are immutable versions identified by a content digest. Only the reviewed active version participates in retrieval. Installing a corrected version does not activate it automatically.

documents.title: Transcript privacy
documents.content: Model transcripts are encrypted with a local key. Missing keys fail closed for an existing encrypted database. Exported evaluation artifacts omit private email bodies, account identities and OAuth tokens.

documents.title: Retrieval timing notebook
documents.content: The latency notebook records local retrieval wall-clock time. Fixture results do not prove production throughput. Search timing excludes corpus installation and document embedding indexing.

documents.content: The database retry setting is exponential backoff with a maximum of four retries. Retry jitter is enabled. The incident owner checks the write-ahead log before repeating a transaction.
